why_chosen: Singapore-headquartered MAS-regulated insurer and financial services group that hires both relationship-type and operations roles; plausible but less obvious than the big local banks.

identity.summary: Real MAS-regulated composite insurer, founded 2017, merged with Aviva Singapore, owned 100% by Sumitomo Life since March 2024. Merger year differs between company page (2022) and Wikipedia (announced 2020).
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search surfaced Wikipedia, the company site and a regulator-based directory; Wikipedia and the company page extracted cleanly.
identity.what_was_missing: Registration details (UEN) and a single consistent founding/merger timeline.

business_and_headcount.summary: Life/health/savings/investment insurer, top five by premiums per Straits Times; PIAS distribution arm sold to its management May 2026. Headcount only from a scraped contact directory (987), not official.
business_and_headcount.how_openserp_helped: Found news and company pages; the ST lead paragraph extracted.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: Official headcount; the ST article body was paywalled.

financial_performance.summary: Audited FY2025 statements located but could not be extracted; no verified profit or growth figure. Only a qualitative CEO growth claim and a group-level Sumitomo premium growth snippet.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Search found the right primary documents.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: PDF extraction returned 502, so the numbers were unreadable.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No Singlife layoff found in two searches and the layoff tracker feed (which was uninformative). PIAS divestment is the only restructuring found.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: Gave Singapore-wide layoff context and the PIAS item.
layoffs_restructuring.what_was_missing: Company-specific confirmation; results were dominated by generic Singapore layoff articles, so the negative evidence is weak.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Glassdoor snippets show roughly 3.5-3.6/5 from about 240-254 reviews and 54% recommend; no review text read.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Search returned many Glassdoor/Jobstreet pages with rating numbers in snippets.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Glassdoor extract failed (502); no actual employee comments.

pay_and_benefits.summary: Only a Glassdoor snippet (RM average '$39,000', period unclear) and market-wide operations analyst ranges from Jobstreet/Indeed. Benefits not found.
pay_and_benefits.how_openserp_helped: Found the salary pages and a headline number in snippets.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Readable salary tables, units, sample sizes and benefits.

interview_and_hiring.summary: Only know Glassdoor has about 35 interview reviews and that a Relationship Consultant listing existed in 2023. No process details or red flags.
interview_and_hiring.what_was_missing: Page content (Glassdoor extraction failed); results also drifted to unrelated generic interview guides.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: MAS fined Singlife Financial Advisers S$93,750 in Sept 2025 over agent recruitment and supervision failures, with prohibition orders on the former CEO and two ex-representatives. The hiring-scam search was blocked by a Google CAPTCHA.
red_flags_and_scams.how_openserp_helped: Found and extracted the primary regulator page in full, plus the company response and trade press.
red_flags_and_scams.what_was_missing: The scam/impersonation check was not completed; one trade snippet gave a different fine amount (S$72,937).

recent_news.summary: NHG Health partnership (Oct 2026), CEO open to M&A (Oct 2026), PIAS sale (May 2026), gold-backed ILPs (Feb 2026), office move (Jan 2026). One aggregator claim of an Oct 2026 Sumitomo acquisition appears wrong.
recent_news.how_openserp_helped: One news query returned current, dated items from several outlets.
recent_news.what_was_missing: Full article text for paywalled items.

misleading_or_wrong_results: Layoff query returned generic Singapore layoff articles, none about Singlife
Interview query returned unrelated SATS, MOM and generic case-interview pages
fundz.net claims Sumitomo acquired Singlife in Oct 2026 (conflicts with March 2024 completion)
insuranceasia snippet gave the fine as S$72,937 versus MAS S$93,750
Singlife about page says merger 2022, Wikipedia says announced 2020

verdict.reasoning: OpenSERP was strong for identity, regulator findings and news, where it reached primary sources. It was weak for the review-site content a job seeker most needs (Glassdoor extraction failed), and bing searches were slow (25 to 37 seconds each). Google hit a CAPTCHA on first use. Usable as a starting point, not as the only source.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: Offer letter terms: salaried vs commission, probation, bonus
Confirmation of which Singlife entity employs the role (insurer vs financial advisers vs distribution)
Current MyCareersFuture or company job post for the exact role
A check of the MAS public register for representatives
